data.review_body: I ordered an essential phone-repair part on June 25. AliExpress’s U.S. last-mile courier, GOFO, marked a valid forwarding-warehouse address as insufficient even though I confirmed it repeatedly. GOFO later said the parcel was back at its warehouse and promised redelivery, but weeks passed without delivery or proactive notice. On July 24 GOFO said the parcel had been “marked for disposition, likely at the seller’s request,” yet provided no proof, date, or prior warning. AliExpress should urgently coordinate with its courier and seller, stop any disposition, locate and deliver the parcel, or send a replacement through a reliable carrier. I can provide the complete tracking and WhatsApp record privately.
data.review_headline: AliExpress courier held my parcel and marked it for disposition

data.review_body:
1 star is too much ! We've just had enough of AliExpress. The platform used to be a good alternative for some items... but its customer service has become the worst ever ! 
Last experience, we ordered a velvet jewellery box, to be given as a gift. The box arrived smashed. So it does not close properly and some interior parts have left marks on the velvet lining... which is ugly and no longer presentable.
We contacted the customer service which after reviewing the photos promised a replacement part. They gave us a tracking number. For multiple days, a couple of weeks, it was noted that the supposed parcel arrived... But, it didn't! It was actually somewhere in the country... but never arrived to our town at all. 
We re-contacted the customer service again... this time they asked for a video and bla bla bla... Then the 30 days return period ended.
End of the story for AliExpress :)
Never again... this comes from us and our acquaintance.

Update: reply on Aliexpress' answer:
After this post I got a silly message from the agent asking me to go back in time for about one month or so, and do an unboxing video.
I mean a jump in time of just one month should be manageable by anybody right?
data.review_headline: 1 star is too much ! Never again !

data.review_body: Have had a recent Blood Pressure issue. GP advised to monitor a couple of times per day. Decided to purchase a "Smart Bracelet" (not the cheep and cheerful one) from AliExpress. Description said it would also monitor BP along with other actions.When I received it it was obvious that it wouldn't achieve what I wanted (down to poor description). Regretfully decided to return it as description not correct. Contacted AliExpress via website, filled in the forms requested and was told that I would have to pay the return postage and they would investigate and get back to me with details in 24 - 48 hours, that was four days ago, nothing. They are quick to sell but not to refund. I have purchased from them before without issue but never again.
data.review_headline: Avoid if you have an issue.
